title: Life-OS Export Freshness
dataSources: Habit activity (`lifeos:habit`), streaks (`lifeos:streak`), Beeminder goals (`lifeos:beeminder`), OKRs (`lifeos:okr`), planning syncs (`lifeos:ops`).
app: Personal life-OS telemetry — Habitica quest logs, Streaks app habit chains, Beeminder goal data, and personal OKR reviews — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:ops source_name=* source_event_epoch=* export_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((export_epoch-source_event_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by source_name
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures life-OS export lag by data source for life-OS sync feeds.
value: Lag tracking shows which data source create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside life-OS sync feeds.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `life-OS export lag` on `lifeos:ops` events and aggregate them by `source_name`.
visualization: Table of data source with average and worst life-OS export lag.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how long things take for each data source so you can see where life-OS sync feeds slows down.
